# UrPassport NG

UrPassport NG is a web app that helps Nigerians handle passport renewal, visa
applications, flight search, and trip planning from one account.

## What it does

- Passport Hub: tracks a Nigerian passport renewal against a document
  checklist, plus a name comparison tool that runs in the browser.
- Visa Assistant: covers all 193 countries. The UK, US, Canada, UAE, France and
  Ghana have researched guides with saved, trackable applications. Other
  countries show a general checklist and a live requirement status from a
  third-party API.
- Document Vault: private, per-user file storage for travel documents, with
  expiry-date tracking and reminder emails.
- Flights: flight search and fare holding via the Duffel API.
- AI Trip Planner: generates a day-by-day itinerary from a destination,
  dates, and budget.
- Billing: Paystack checkout for a small set of paid add-ons.
- Family: manage passport and visa applications on behalf of dependants.

## Access

The homepage, login, terms, privacy and auth reset pages are public. Dashboard
routes require a Supabase-authenticated account. The Paystack webhook and
expiry reminder cron are provider-only endpoints.

## Disclaimer

Not affiliated with the Nigeria Immigration Service or any government body.
